message: 噂の影にやっぱりさっちん

name: Synn
message: 「Heeey, Paqy. Your food's gonna get coooold.」

name: Synn
message: 「He's got such a peaceful sleeping face...」
I'm scared to tell him the truth, but I have to do it sooner rather than later.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it's about time I went to pick up Ria-senpai--」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm? Wonder who that could be.」

name: Synn
message: 「Comiiing.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Nobody's here.」

name: Ria
message: 「Gueeess who.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!!」
This voice is--

name: Ria
message: 「Ehehe, I came over♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai!」

name: Ria
message: 「Let's walk to school together.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Your house is right next to the school, Senpai! If we're going to walk together, I should be the one picking you up!」

name: Ria
message: 「Once we get to school, we have to split up right away, don't we? If we did that, we'd have less time together...」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「So... please...」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Okay, I got it!」

name: Ria
message: 「Yay♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ria-chan!? Don't tell me you came to gently wake yours truly up!?」

name: Synn
message: 「You're already awake.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then did you come to treat me to an elegant breakfast!!」

name: Synn
message: 「The one I made is sitting right there wrapped in plastic.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then what did you even come here for.」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Um... well...」
Ria-senpai is in a bind.... As a man, I have to step in for her here.

name: Synn
message: 「A-Actually, Paqy. I... started dating someone. U-Um... Ria-senpai.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Huh? Wait, are you telling me the Demon Lord is Ria-chan's boyfriend? Don't joke around--」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-Yeah... seriously, I'm his girlfriend.\s03」

name: Paqy
message: 「W-Whaaat!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, what did you have for breakfast today?」

name: Synn
message: 「Egg over rice.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's no good, Synn-kun. You have to eat a proper breakfast. Otherwise, you won't be bursting with energy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Bursting with energy, huh.\s02」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides, you're still in your growth spurt, so you have to eat plenty and grow big and tall.」

name: Synn
message: 「Big and tall...」
Right now, I'm about the same height as Ria-senpai, or if things go badly, maybe even shorter.
As her boyfriend, this might be a grave situation.

name: Synn
message: 「A-All riiight. From now on, I'll add one more dish. Finely shredded green onions.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, yeah. That's the spirit.」

name: Ria
message: 「--Hey, that's not nearly enough! You at least need to add bacon and eggs.」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, what do you plan to do by fattening me up? Ah, I get it. You're planning to eat me, aren't you.」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, saying weird things like that. It can't be helped, so I'll make breakfast for you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem! Ria-senpai's Synn-kun Raising Plan~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I couldn't possibly trouble you like that. You're already coming to pick me up as it is.」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't hold back around your girlfriend. That's when you gotta be bold.」

name: Ria
message: 「Like, 'You are forbidden from going to sleep before me!!'\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「What kind of domineering husband is that? Saying something like that to my senpai...」
Wait a second? Taking the lead like a man here might not be a bad move.

name: Synn
message: 「There are things only you can do. Don't butt in on anything else--just shut up and follow me!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey now. Don't get carried away!\s05」
Smiling, Ria-senpai gave the tip of my nose a light poke.

name: Ria
message: 「From now on, is it okay if I drop by unannounced?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, that's fine. Ria-senpai is, um... well...」

name: Synn
message: 「B-Because, you're my, girlfriend, after all.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Good morning to you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Good morning!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah... good morning, Akane-chan.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh my. Walking to school together--you two certainly seem awfully close.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Almost like a pair of lovers.」

name: Ria
message: 「A-As expected of Akane-chan... nothing gets past you.\s02」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Eh... wait, is it true?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes... thanks to you.\s03」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Oh~~ my~~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「No wonder Paqy-san looks like his soul has left his body.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I figured it'd be worse to keep hiding it.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Wouldn't it be more accurate to say you couldn't hide it even if you tried?」

name: Synn
message: 「Urk!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「At any rate, congratulations.」

name: Ria
message: 「W-When you put it like that, it's embarrassing...\s03 But, thank you.\s04」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Kaichou-han. If you ever do anything to make Rii-a sad...」

name: Synn
message: 「Waaah, I get it, I get it!! It'll be fine. You can leave Ria-senpai completely to me!」

name: Ria
message: 「J-Jeez, Synn-kun...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee... You two are so lovey-dovey it's too much for me. I can't bear to watch any longer.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Gasp. To think Synn-kun and Ria-senpai became lovers...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「T-This is a huge deal. Big news. I have to go tell everyone right away.」

name: Everyone
message: 「W-Whaaaat!?」

name: Synn
message: 「The school just shook...」

name: Ria
message: 「Could it be the effects of Re-Crea...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Good morning, Mr. President and Miss Senpai.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, morning, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And, congratulations on your marriage.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, thank you.」

name: Ria
message: 「--Wait, hey!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And they lived happily ever after. My, I suppose I must call Miss Senpai a bride now.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's not it\s03 We just started going out normally~~」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Marriage... I-It's still way too soon...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that so... In that case--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aha!! You two are what they call a lovey-dovey idiot couple♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Fine, whatever, just go with that.\s02」

name: Ria
message: 「We haven't told anyone at all that I'm dating Synn-kun yet, so how do you know?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, you see--」

name: Shio
message: 「Well, well, look at the two of you. Seeing you on such intimate terms makes me gaze upon you with a touch of envy, indeed.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even Shio-chan!?」

name: Shio
message: 「With Christmas drawing near these days, one naturally longs for the warmth of another's touch. Giving in to that yearning, warming both heart and body--」

name: Shio
message: 「Ha--!? Wh-what shameless thoughts am I entertaining!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Having one's heart stolen by the opposite sex is utterly outrageous. Without extinguishing the ego, there is no victory. I must train to cast aside all worldly distractions!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Waaah, don't go on a rampage!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister, please tell me it's a lie!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Another one popped up...」

name: Misa
message: 「Even though I, too, have adored you from the bottom of my heart, Big Sister!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-that's, um...」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I'm sorry!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ngh... I lost again...!」

name: Synn
message: 「This isn't some kind of competition...」

name: Misa
message: 「It's fine!! I still have Paqy-san!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Aah... Could it be that I was projecting her image onto Ria-chan...?」

name: Misa
message: 「Comfort me, Paqy-san!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Knock it off, Hiss!! Don't interrupt a guy while he's soaking in sentimentality!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah, geez, how did this turn into such a commotion.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's true, I tell you. There's even a witness--」

name: Sally
message: 「Yep. The maid saw it all!! The President and Ria doing this and that inside the room!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-Is it already too late... *slump*」

name: Helena
message: 「Now that sounds interesting. Why don't you tell me all about it in detail.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... So that's the root of all this.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There's no choice now but to announce this in a special extra edition!」

name: Helena
message: 「Here's the headline: A Student Council President Couple Is Born. Forbidden Love.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'll go print this right away~」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaah, hey, wait a second!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan... looks like Operation Lovey-Dovey was a total bust.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sh-Shut up!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Don't cry, okay? You're gonna make me cry too.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm not crying!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Nanaka-chan...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-H-Hey there, you two.」

name: Synn
message: 「I was meaning to tell you properly, but things ended up like this...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「'Like this'? This is huge news! Two of the biggest celebrities at school dating is a total scoop~」

name: Synn
message: 「So you're the culprit, Sacchin...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ah, whoops~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-Isn't it fine? Your wish came true, after all... Um, well...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A... Ahem.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Congratulations, you two.」

name: Ria
message: 「...Thank you, Nanaka-chan!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah! Well, catch you later!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, Nanaka!! Wait--」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No can do, Synn-kun. If you hurt Nana-chan any more than this, I won't forgive you~」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What do you mean?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You total blockhead!! Not even noticing Nana's feelings, you're the worst.」

name: Ria
message: 「Nanaka, I knew it...」

name: Synn
message: 「So, Sacchin. What's with that hand.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Aww. Guess begging Synn-kun was useless after all~」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, are you going to cover for me?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well~. To be fair, Nana was a total coward too~. I just couldn't stand watching anymore~」

name: Ria
message: 「I-I'll go after her!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's fine, Ria-senpai. After all, Nana managed to properly say congratulations~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「She'll be fine once she eats some cake~. I'll go with her today or something~」

name: Synn
message: 「...Thanks, Sacchin.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Not at all~. You always look out for me, Synn-kun~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Phew~. Guess that keeps me from getting charged with spreading rumors~」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「See ya~\s01」
Without the two of them ever saying a word, the rumor spread on its own, yet everyone gave their blessing to their relationship.

name: Synn
message: 「Haaah...」

name: Ria
message: 「Ufufu, good work today. Right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Preparations for the Holy Night Festival, plus special training with the Demon Lord. Having them back-to-back really wears you out.」

name: Ria
message: 「You've been holding back all this time, haven't you, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, well, I wouldn't really call it holding back...」
Holding back from grinning like an idiot in front of everyone today was way harder, honestly.

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, your hand. Hold it out.」

name: Synn
message: 「My hand?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah♪」
I wonder what she's planning to do, taking my hand like that.

name: Ria
message: 「Haaah.」
Ria-senpai blew a warm breath onto it.
Then, after adding a touch of moisture, she pressed her palm against mine and rubbed them together.
The soft sensation caught me off guard

name: Synn
message: 「Uwaaah!」
A thumb was pressed firmly into my palm.

name: Synn
message: 「W-What are you doing?!」

name: Ria
message: 「A palm massage.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「A-A massage?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hurts so good, right? Take that! And that!」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Ow-ow-ow!」

name: Ria
message: 「Apparently there's a pressure point here that relieves eye strain. Something on TV said so.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, you don't have to practice it on me--owww-ow-ow!!」

name: Ria
message: 「You're a boy, so don't whine about the pain so much. It's unseemly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Boy or not, what hurts hurts! If that's how you feel, should I do it to you too, Ria-senpai?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Sure, go ahead♪」
Seeing her accept so readily made my earlier thrashing around look pretty pathetic.
The palm she held out was fair and translucent, yet warm to the touch.
Still, how am I supposed to do this? She's a girl, so I can't press too hard, so I'll just try pushing around gently.
Haaah... Ria-senpai's palm is so squishy and soft...
Before I knew it, wanting to savor the feel of her smooth skin, I stopped pressing and began sliding the pads of my fingers across it.

name: Ria
message: 「Ah... ngh... mmm! That tickles!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「I-If you do it like that... it's not a massage...」

name: Synn
message: 「Waaah!! No, no!! I just got carried away!」

name: Ria
message: 「Carried away...?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No... I just, well, wasn't really sure how to do it, that's all.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, I see. Let's switch then.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I'm good now.」

name: Ria
message: 「Too bad♪」
Still, Ria-senpai's hand was so warm and soft...
Ahh, I want to squeeze that hand tight...
But if I grab it out of nowhere, I'll probably startle her, and yet saying "Let's hold hands" is way too embarrassing.
Casually... casually...
Right now, while we're walking close together, is my chance.
I reach out to catch Ria-senpai's palm as she hums a tune!!

name: Ria
message: 「Kyah!?」
However, my outstretched hand completely missed the mark and ended up grabbing something outrageous instead.
It was even softer than a palm--

name: Ria
message: 「Sh-Synn-kun...」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Suddenly doing something like that...」

name: Synn
message: 「N-N-No, you've got it wrong!! I definitely wasn't trying to touch your butt--」

name: Ria
message: 「Then what were you trying to do.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That is...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「I wanted to hold hands, sir. With you, Ria-senpai...」
Overwhelmed by embarrassment, I slipped into stiff jock-speak.

name: Ria
message: 「I-I see... If that's all, you should've just said so...」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I wouldn't have ended up touching your butt either...」

name: Ria
message: 「Even with my butt, if you'd just asked--」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh.」

name: Ria
message: 「Take this!!」
Our hands linked together, radiating warmth.
Under the chilly sky, that warmth felt like pure bliss.

name: Ria
message: 「Holding hands kinda makes us seem like a couple, doesn't it...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「Aren't we, though?」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, right. My bad, my bad.\s02」
Ria-senpai said, sticking her tongue out playfully.

name: Synn
message: 「...Shall we head home?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, let's go♪ Then all the way to your house--」

name: Synn
message: 「No way!! Picking me up is one thing, but I'm definitely the one walking you home!!」

name: Ria
message: 「My house is right outside the school gate, you know...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Then let's stop by somewhere on the way. That way, we can keep...」
When I tightened my grip, Ria-senpai squeezed back--

name: Ria
message: 「W-W-Wait a second, time out!!」
Ria-senpai suddenly let go of my hand, took out a handkerchief, and wiped her palm.

name: Ria
message: 「H-Here you go.\s01」
Apparently, our hands had gotten sweaty.

name: Synn
message: 「I-In that case, I'm the same...」

name: Ria
message: 「J-Jeez, Synn-kun--\s03」
What are we even doing.
Even though we still can't even hold hands normally yet.
Step by step, closing the distance between the two of us.
And may we someday grow close enough that our hearts overlap.
